result.instructions: Tools for InnoVint, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my lots are currently in the aging stage?"; "Show the last five pH and free SO2 results for lot 24CAB01."; "What additions and racking did we do on the 2026 Pinot lots this week?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes InnoVint data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run innovint_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run innovint_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run innovint_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. innovint_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.title: List wineries
tools.description: List the connected winery with id, name and the user's permissions. Hosted connections and scoped stdio return only the selected winery; unscoped stdio lists all accessible wineries. GET /api/v1/wineries or /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}.

tools.name: innovint_create_analysis_action
tools.title: Record analysis results
tools.description: WRITE: records analysis results (e.g. pH 3.45, free SO2 28 mg/L) as a new analysis action in the winery's InnoVint records, effective at the given time. Each result needs an analysis type slug (innovint_list_analysis_types), a value and a unit, and a lot (add a vessel for a vessel-level result; without a vessel it is a lot composite result). The new action shows up in the cellar history and feeds lot data and reports; InnoVint's API has no delete here, so only call this when the numbers are confirmed. POST /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}/actions/analysisActions.

winery_id.description: InnoVint winery id; list yours with innovint_list_wineries (e.g. wnry_0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMN).

effective_at.description: When the analysis was done (ISO 8601 with timezone, e.g. 2026-10-24T09:30:00Z).

unit.description: Unit of the value, e.g. "g/L" or "mg/L" (use the unit InnoVint lists for the type).

vessel_id.description: Vessel id for a vessel-level result; omit for a lot composite result (e.g. ves_0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMN).

panel_name.description: Optional name of the panel/report these results belong to.

note.description: Optional note saved with the action.

tools.name: innovint_create_vendor
tools.title: Create vendor
tools.description: WRITE: adds a new vendor (supplier) by name to the winery's InnoVint records. Check innovint_list_vendors first to avoid a duplicate. POST /api/v1/wineries/{wineryId}/vendors.

winery_id.description: InnoVint winery id; list yours with innovint_list_wineries (e.g. wnry_0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMN).
